tagline: Innovative construction chemistry solutions for sustainable building
hero_kpi_rationale: Material margin is the primary profitability driver in Sika's business model, reflecting its ability to absorb cost increases and maintain solid margins despite inflation. It is a key structural indicator in building specialty chemicals.

kpis.name: Material Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between selling price and cost of raw materials, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Material margin improved to 55.0% in 2025 (9 months) versus 54.7% in 2024 (9 months), despite market headwinds, driven by lower input costs and MBCC integration synergies.
kpis.signal: Continuous improvement despite inflation and weak Chinese market

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total annual net sales of the company.
kpis.description: Revenue amounted to CHF 8.58 billion (9 months 2025), growing 1.1% in local currencies despite a 3.8% decline in Swiss francs due to US dollar weakness. Organic growth was flat, offset by acquisition impact.
kpis.signal: Moderate local currency growth despite Chinese market headwinds

kpis.name: EBITDA Margin
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization relative to revenue.
kpis.description: EBITDA margin stood at 19.2% in 2025 (9 months) versus 19.1% in 2024 (9 months), driven by lower input costs and MBCC synergies, partially offset by weak Chinese market impact.

kpis.name: EBIT Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit relative to revenue, reflecting profitability before financing.
kpis.description: EBIT margin stood at 14.4% in 2025 (9 months) versus 14.5% in 2024 (9 months), slightly impacted by increased depreciation and amortization following strategic acquisitions.

kpis.name: EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operating earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization in absolute value.
kpis.description: EBITDA amounted to CHF 1.64 billion in 2025 (9 months) versus CHF 1.70 billion in 2024 (9 months), decline primarily due to significant FX effects rather than operational deterioration.
kpis.signal: FX effects impact on absolute profitability

kpis.name: Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Operating profit after depreciation and amortization.
kpis.description: Operating profit (EBIT) amounted to CHF 1.238 billion in 2025 (9 months) versus CHF 1.295 billion in 2024 (9 months), decline related to FX effects and Chinese market operational impacts.
kpis.signal: Operating profit affected by FX effects

kpis.name: Net Profit
kpis.explanation: Net profit attributable to Sika shareholders after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net profit amounted to CHF 0.870 billion in 2025 (9 months) versus CHF 0.921 billion in 2024 (9 months), decline reflecting FX pressures and market headwinds.
kpis.signal: Net profit impacted by macroeconomic effects

kpis.name: Organic Growth
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth adjusted to eliminate FX effects and acquisitions.
kpis.description: Organic growth was flat in 2025 (9 months), despite 1.1% local currency growth, offset by neutral net acquisition contribution.
kpis.signal: Stagnant organic growth reflecting Chinese market headwinds

kpis.name: Regional Growth EMEA (in local currencies)
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth in the Europe, Middle East, Africa region in local currencies.
kpis.description: The EMEA region recorded 2.1% local currency growth in 2025 (9 months), reflecting mild construction market recovery in Europe, particularly in Middle East and Africa with double digit growth.

kpis.name: Regional Growth Americas (in local currencies)
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth in the Americas region in local currencies.
kpis.description: Americas recorded 2.9% local currency growth in 2025 (9 months), slowing from 12.2% in 2024 due to US trade measures, partially offset by strong Latin American performance.
kpis.signal: US growth deceleration due to political uncertainties

kpis.name: Regional Growth Asia Pacific (in local currencies)
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth in the Asia-Pacific region in local currencies.
kpis.description: Asia-Pacific region recorded a 3.9% local currency decline in 2025 (9 months), primarily due to deflating Chinese construction market. Excluding double digit Chinese market decline, the region would have recorded approximately 4% growth.
kpis.signal: Pronounced decline due to Chinese construction market deflation

kpis.name: Fast Forward Program Investment
kpis.explanation: Total planned investment amount in the Fast Forward efficiency and innovation program.
kpis.description: Sika is investing between CHF 120 and 150 million (median range: CHF 135 million) in the Fast Forward program, designed to accelerate innovation, digital transformation and improve operational excellence during 2025-2028.
kpis.signal: Major strategic investment for digital acceleration and growth

kpis.name: Fast Forward Program Annual Savings
kpis.explanation: Cumulative annual savings expected from the Fast Forward program starting 2028.
kpis.description: The Fast Forward program is expected to generate annual savings between CHF 150 and 200 million (median range: CHF 175 million) from 2028 onwards, with significant portion from structural adjustments in China (approximately 1,500 headcount reduction).
kpis.signal: Generation of major structural savings linked to Chinese market adjustments

kpis.name: One-off Costs China Restructuring
kpis.explanation: One-time costs anticipated for structural adjustments in China, including workforce reductions.
kpis.description: Sika anticipates one-off costs between CHF 80 and 100 million (median range: CHF 90 million) in 2025 for structural adjustments in China, including approximately 1,500 employee reductions.
kpis.signal: Major structural adjustments in response to persistent Chinese market challenges

kpis.name: Acquisitions and New Factories
kpis.explanation: Total number of acquisitions completed and new factories opened in 2025 (first 9 months).
kpis.description: Sika completed 5 acquisitions and opened 7 new factories in the first 9 months of 2025, confirming its commitment to strengthening its global position in key North American and EMEA markets.
kpis.signal: Strategic investments to strengthen global market position

risks.title: Dependency on successful integration of major acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: Major risk explicitly mentioned: MBCC acquisition (largest in Sika history) with 6,000 new employees and CHF 2.1 billion in additional sales. Intensive language (largest acquisition, integration costs CHF 131.5 million). Trend: up (recent May 2023 acquisition). Category weight: critical for 2028 strategy.

risks.title: Market fragmentation and increasing competitive intensity
risks.score_rationale: Explicit position: Sika holds 11% global market share in a sector where top 10 players control only 40%. Moderate language but clear context. Trend: stable (persistent market structure). Category weight: high for organic growth strategy.

risks.title: Currency volatility and diversified geographic exposure
risks.score_rationale: Quantified and significant impact: negative FX effect of -7.4% (CHF 2.1 billion) in 2023 despite 14.5% organic growth in local currencies. Intensive language (record negative currency effect). Trend: up (persistent pressures). Category weight: high for company operating in 103 countries.

risks.title: Dependency on product innovation and R&D
risks.score_rationale: Key resource identified: 1,780 R&D employees, 18 global technology centers, 108 new patents in 2023. Moderate but strategic language (innovation leader). Trend: stable (continuous investment). Category weight: medium-high for product differentiation.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance and environmental risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicit commitment: Net Zero target, 4.4% GHG reduction per tonne in 2023, 12.2% water consumption reduction. Moderate but visible commitment language. Trend: up (rising environmental standards). Category weight: medium for construction sector.

risks.title: Dependency on economic cycles and construction activity
risks.score_rationale: Explicit context: challenging economic environment, high inflation, elevated interest rates, construction slowdown (Germany, Austria, Northern Europe). Moderate but repeated language. Trend: up (2024 forecasts indicate challenges). Category weight: high for cyclical sector.

risks.title: Supply chain risks and supplier dependency
risks.score_rationale: Critical resource identified: >18,000 suppliers, CHF 5.214 billion material spending. Moderate language (mutually beneficial relationships). Trend: stable (supply chain normalization mentioned). Category weight: medium for manufacturing sector.

risks.title: Specialized labor shortage and talent retention
risks.score_rationale: Explicit context: increasing shortage of specialized labor mentioned for Americas. Key resource: 33,547 employees, 24.3% women, 25% women in management. Moderate language. Trend: up (increasing shortage). Category weight: medium for labor intensive sector.

ai_positioning.summary: Sika makes no mention of artificial intelligence or AI-related strategy or initiatives in its first half 2025 report. The company does not position AI as a key technology lever for its products or processes, although it mentions digital acceleration within the Fast Forward program.
evidence: No specific mention of AI or machine learning in the nine-month 2025 report
Fast Forward program mentions digital acceleration without reference to AI
Focus on MBCC integration, sustainable chemistry, operational excellence and weak market management
